messages:
jon_d: Hey team — our customers are seeing failures hitting /v1/rerank. Happens intermittently but reliably when the candidate texts come from an old ingestion pipeline that sometimes inserts null bytes or weird byte sequences. We get 400s and 500s. Example payload attached below. Any quick guidance?

maria_s: Sorry about this, jon. Can you paste the exact payload and any request-id or headers? Do you have a curl or SDK call that reproduces it?

jon_d: Sure — here's a sanitized example we sent (we replaced PII):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
User-Agent: our-service/1.2.3
X-Request-ID: req_01F7Z9ABC

{
  "query": "find cafés\u0000 in seattle",
  "candidates": [
    "Café Nordstrom",
    "Café on 3rd",      // note combining accent vs precomposed
    "OldDB\u0000\ud83d\ude02garbage", // null + emoji + leftover invalid bytes from import
    "Neighborhood café 🔥"
  ]
}
```

jon_d: When we send that, sometimes response is 400 with body: `{"error":"invalid input"}` and other times 500 with no useful error. Trace header: `x-rdwn-request: req_01F7Z9ABC`

maria_s: Thanks — I'm looking at our logs now. I can reproduce locally by sending a payload with literal null bytes. Repro curl I used:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: repro-null-2026' \
  --data $'{"query":"a\u0000b","candidates":["x","y\u0000z"]}'
```

maria_s: Local result: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Response body: `{"error":"internal server error"}`
Server logs show: `UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x80 in position 12: invalid start byte` from ujson.loads in rerank handler. Stack trace snippet:
```
File "/opt/runtime/handlers/rerank.py", line 78, in handle
  payload = ujson.loads(body)
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x80 in position 12
```

ingrid_ml: Looks like the reranker stack assumes strict UTF-8 and doesn't sanitize or validate inputs before model tokenization. Null bytes are creating malformed sequences after some normalization steps (combining characters + null -> invalid sequences). Also we've seen emojis encoded as surrogate pairs from certain clients which sometimes produce invalid byte sequences when re-encoded.

lee_r: Assigning to eng-runtime. Action items I propose: (1) validate request body encoding at ingress and return 400 with a clear message `invalid encoding: non-utf8 bytes or nulls` instead of 500; (2) optionally strip NUL (\u0000) bytes at proxy layer as a temporary mitigation; (3) add a sanitizer feature toggle to Redwood Gateway to optionally replace/normalize control characters and invalid sequences.

priya_sre: Adding repro steps for eng: I was able to reproduce with node too. Example node repro to send a literal null in body:
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const body = JSON.stringify({query: "a\u0000b", candidates: ["foo\u0000bar"]});
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', {method:'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'X-Request-ID':'node-repro-2026'}, body})
  .then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>console.log(t));
```

maria_s: Temporary mitigation for jon: we can enable a request rewrite rule on your org's proxied route to strip `\u0000` characters and normalize to NFC. Would you like us to do that while eng adds a proper fix?

jon_d: Yes please — that would unblock us. Also, is there any guidance we should give our ingestion team? They're still producing these legacy artifacts.

maria_s: Guidance to ingestion team: ensure all text is normalized to NFC and remove control characters before storing. In Python: `clean = s.replace("\u0000", "")` and `clean = unicodedata.normalize('NFC', clean)`. In Node: `clean = value.replace(/\u0000/g, '')` and use `String.prototype.normalize('NFC')`. We'll include these snippets in the support ticket.

lee_r: For the engineering fix: I'll create a follow-up PR to the runtime router that does early decoding with strict error handling and returns 400 with this JSON shape: `{"error":"invalid_encoding","message":"request body contains non-UTF-8 or control characters (\u0000)"}`. Also adding a flag to allow automatic sanitizer at the gateway for backward compatibility.

maria_s: Ticket created: INC-2026-encoding-rerank (internal). Marking priority P2 unless this escalates more customers. cc @ingrid_ml for possible model tokenization hardening.

jon_d: Thanks all, please enable the proxy strip for our org (org_88A). I'll wait for confirmation before flipping anything on our side. :pray:

incident-bot: INC-2026-encoding-rerank assigned to eng-runtime, current status: triaged.

maria_s: Confirmed — temporary strip rule enabled for org_88A. Please verify and report if you still see errors.

jon_d: Verified — requests with the previous failing payload now return 200 and results look sane. Huge help, thanks! :tada:

lee_r: We'll follow up with a code change and a changelog entry. Will post PR link when ready.

maria_s: Closing the slack thread but keeping the ticket open until runtime PR is merged. Thanks everyone.
